title: Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward
use_en: Progressive skill loading; a survey, not a direct architecture performance test.
use_es: Carga progresiva de skills; revisión, no prueba comparativa directa.

title: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Financial Document Processing: A Comparative Study of Orchestration Patterns, Cost-Accuracy Tradeoffs and Production Scaling Strategies
use_en: Sequential, parallel, supervisor-worker and reflexive patterns; SEC-document scope and January 2025 model/pricing setup limit transfer.
use_es: Patrones secuencial, paralelo, supervisor-trabajador y reflexivo; alcance documental SEC y configuración de enero de 2025 limitan la extrapolación.

title: CRAFT: Grounded Multi-Agent Coordination Under Partial Information
authors: Abhijnan Nath, Hannah VanderHoeven and Nikhil Krishnaswamy
use_en: Partial observations and communication failures; grounded construction differs from full-input microtasks.
use_es: Observaciones parciales y fallos de comunicación; construcción situada distinta de microtareas con entrada completa.

title: EvoAgent: An Evolvable Agent Framework with Skill Learning and Multi-Agent Delegation
authors: Aimin Zhang, Jiajing Guo, Fuwei Jia, Chen Lv, Boyu Wang and Fangzheng Li
use_en: Hierarchical delegation and staged skill matching; domain-specific model-judge evaluation, not exact task execution.
use_es: Delegación jerárquica y selección escalonada de skills; evaluación de dominio mediante juez modelo, no ejecución exacta de tareas.

title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering
use_en: Portable role/workflow/boundary specification; qualitative case with broad conformance testing still missing.
use_es: Especificación de roles, flujos y límites; caso cualitativo con validación amplia de compatibilidad pendiente.

title: When Does Hierarchy Help? Benchmarking Agent Coordination in Event-Driven Industrial Scheduling
authors: Ziqi Wang, Yuhao Yang, Zhiwei Ling, Wenzhuo Qian and Hailiang Zhao
use_en: Centralized, hierarchical, mediated heterarchical and holonic authority; industrial scheduling evidence.
use_es: Autoridad centralizada, jerárquica, heterárquica mediada y holónica; evidencia en planificación industrial.

title: Beyond Sequential Interaction: Benchmarking Parallel Execution and Coordination for GUI Agents
use_en: Round-based planner with concurrent GUI workers; worker failures and visual-history controls matter.
use_es: Planificador por rondas con trabajadores de interfaz en paralelo; importan fallos del trabajador y control del historial visual.
sections_read: III; IV; V; VI limitations; appendix A-C

title: OrchBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Plans in Isolation via Deterministic Simulation
use_en: Dependency-preserving handoffs and quality/makespan/token axes; simulated worker outcomes are not live API measurements.
use_es: Traspasos que conservan dependencias y ejes calidad/tiempo/tokens; resultados de trabajadores simulados distintos de mediciones API.

title: Subagents vs Agent Skills: Executing Reusable Knowledge for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
authors: Wasu Top Piriyakulkij, Rachel Lawrence, Alicia Curth, Sushrut Karmalkar and Niranjani Prasad
use_en: Procedural skill interfaces and fresh worker context; selected 64-task subset and higher total token cost limit broad claims.
use_es: Interfaces de skills procedurales y contexto independiente; subconjunto seleccionado de 64 tareas y mayor consumo total limitan conclusiones generales.

title: GPT-5.6 Luna Model
use_en: Model id, supported reasoning effort and Responses availability; implementation documentation, outside the arXiv literature corpus.
use_es: Identificador, esfuerzo de razonamiento y API Responses; documentación de implementación fuera del corpus arXiv.
